move: label settles in, ingredient lines and bars reveal in turn, fold up
how: A 1080x1920 cream label card with a serif brand, a subline, a rule, four ingredient rows (name, percentage, and a bar), two juice blobs, a round stamp and a footer. The card comes from scale 0.92 y 60 opacity 0 (expo.out, 0.9s); brand rows and subline rise through masks, the rule grows scaleX from the left, the blobs scale in (expo.out / back.out) and the stamp spins in with back.out(1.6). From 12% each row enters 0.55s apart: its text rises yPercent 120, the divider colour fades in and the bar grows scaleX 0 to 1 to its data width (expo.out, 1s). During the hold the stamp turns 360 and the blobs breathe (sine.inOut yoyo). From 84% the rows and bars fold up and retract to the right (expo.in, 0.08 stagger), the rule and brand follow and the card drops y 120 and fades.
adapt: Change the brand, subline, ingredient names and data-w percentages (any count, 0.55s apart), colours and stamp text; keep the expo.out 1s bar fill and the expo.in fold.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the label and rows; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with rows at (0.12 + i*0.061)D and the exit at 0.84D. Scope selectors to el; direct port.
caveats: width and scaleX are tweened together on the bars, which relayouts each frame
